subject: Add libbacktrace fallback for stack traces on musl/Alpine (#3581)
reason: The change only adds a libbacktrace stack-trace fallback gated behind the USE_LIBBACKTRACE compile-time macro, which defaults to 'no' in the Makefile and is set only for musl/Alpine builds the fuzzer does not produce. On the standard glibc build the fuzzer compiles, HAVE_EXECINFO is defined and every code path is identical to before, so all the new code is compiled out.
